newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Wing Tiek finalising buyout.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Wing Tiek finalising buyout.

text.p: Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd said it is still holding talks on a proposed management buyout and "certain proposed acquisitions", and that it is requesting a resumption in its stock trading in the meantime.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Tuesday, the industrial group said the parties involved in the deals "require more time to finalise the said negotiations" and that details would be announced as soon as terms have been set.
Malaysian markets were closed on Wednesday for the Buddhist Wesak Day observance.

Earlier this month, Wing Tiek said three of its directors, led by executive chairman Lew Sip Hon had signed a management buyout agreement with major shareholder Westmont Holdings Sdn Bhd for the voting rights on 30.23 percent of Wing Tiek's equity.
The purchase of Westmont's equity would trigger a general offer for the rest of the Wing Tiek equity.
Wing Tiek's stock closed at 4.92 ringgit on May 13 and remained suspended from trading on Thursday.
